characters.name: 顾长根
characters.design: 52-year-old male veteran lathe operator of 1990s state-owned factory, wearing dark blue work uniform with matching sleeve covers, low-pressed dark cap, grease stains on calloused fingers, sharp stern eyes, gritty realistic style with authentic worn work wear texture, suggested front waist-up shot to highlight facial expression and oil dirt details on hands, matching 90s industrial period authenticity

characters.name: 大刘
characters.design: 26-year-old male apprentice of the same factory, same dark blue work uniform with sleeves rolled up, short neat black hair, obvious scar on the back of hand, Adam's apple bobbing as he holds back restrained words, realistic style with authentic workshop worn details, suggested medium shot facing the master to show his pent-up emotion and uniform features, consistent with 90s cold workshop atmosphere

props.name: 转岗名单
props.design: Yellowed A4 paper printed with official factory transfer roster seal, handwritten employee names in standard 1990s factory font, one name scribbled out and overwritten with another in messy handwriting, slightly crumpled edges from being stuffed in pocket, realistic paper texture, suggested close-up shot to highlight the altered name detail clearly, matching 90s official document style

issues: 字体风格严重不符：设计要点要求1990年代工厂标准字体，画面呈现为古文/篆书风格，且出现'国尔钍'、'史榜炮'、'贞为升稗'等非正常用字或乱码
缺少官方印章：设计要点要求印有工厂转岗名单印章，画面中未见明显印章痕迹
涂改细节不符：设计要点要求姓名被涂掉后用潦草笔迹覆盖新姓名，画面中仅见涂鸦痕迹，未清晰呈现被覆盖的新姓名

props.name: 老式机床
props.design: 1990s state-owned factory standard old lathe, worn dark metal body with visible rust spots and long-term scratch marks, faded control panel labels, residual metal chips on the base, cold hard industrial material, suggested side three-quarter view to show its worn operational texture and placement in the crowded workshop, consistent with gritty industrial realism

props.name: 车间广播喇叭
props.design: Wall-mounted 1990s factory broadcast speaker, off-white plastic shell with faint age-related yellowing, sturdy metal mounting bracket, slightly dusty surface from long-term use, realistic retro industrial style, suggested low-angle shot to show its fixed position high on the workshop wall, matching period accurate setting details

scenes.name: 1998冬国营机床车间
scenes.design: 1990s Chinese state-owned machine tool workshop in frigid winter, frosted high windows with thick snow piled outside, rows of old machine tools lined up neatly, scattered iron tool cabinets with worn paint, visible breath fog hanging in the cold air, muted cold desaturated color tone, suggested wide environmental shot to show the full crowded workshop atmosphere, consistent with retro documentary industrial realism
